music.prompt: Warm inviting instrumental for a handmade textile studio open weekend. Soft acoustic guitar and gentle organic textures, light hand percussion pulse, friendly and welcoming. Noticeable but soft opening entrance, then spacious mid section with room for on-screen event text, clean natural ending suitable for a short fade. No vocals, no choir, no lyrics, no singing. No trailer risers, no epic cinematic drums, no EDM drop. Not aggressive. Original instrumental only; do not reference any artist, song title, album, or copyrighted melody.
